The leftover ashes are easy to remove. The ash container removes easily. It is a light weight grill too. A good value for this grill due too. I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Master Touch Charcoal Grill Is Great

Results.ReviewText:
I decided to "upgrade" our current 18" weber to the 22" Master touch.   
First off, that little 18" is ten years going strong and plans to be around for many more years so we have no plans to get rid of it.
I gotta tell you, the 22" Master touch is a gorgeous grill.  I purchased the additional rotisserie attachment and we enjoyed one of the best prime rib roasts we've ever had on Christmas day.  Can't wait to rotisserie some chickens on that.
My proclivity to stick with a charcoal grill was my driving force here, as I find my hubby is much more attentive to cooking with charcoal as opposed to a gas grill, though one day we might get another one of those, and you cannot beat the taste of food cooked on a charcoal grill.
The grill itself is so well made and attention to detail is appreciated.   The heat guard on the handle of the lid is a nice updrade and I love the grate with the option to add on different attachments like a griddle, wok, or grilling stone.  We cant wait until the weather gets a little better as we are itching to start grilling again.  Hubby is particularly wanting to try some ribs done on our new Weber so I  will be looking forward to that.
Results.Title: You can cook ANYTHING on a weber

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We will be sure to share this information with our team. If there is anything further we can do to help please let us know. We are here to help. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
Bought from local Ace Hardware as a christmas present. Was missing the char basket and screw for handle. Called weber support and got sent replacements for both with no hassle except the char basket took a couple weeks and came a week late but was getting delivered during winter storm so no complaints there. Putting together the grill was definitely a bit of a hassle and some parts aren't screwed tight and it came with a warming rack which I don't really use so it's just collecting dust in the garage. Overall I think getting the original 22 inch is definitely more worth it than the master touch. For almost 300 dollars the quality wasn't really up to my expectations and the original is about half the price and can do what the master touch can do. If you grill everyday or something I guess this would be worth it for the ash catcher, char basket, and increased height but if you're a beginner or don't grill that much I would definitely recommend getting the original. Honestly the dome thermometer also is something I don't really look at so save the money and use it to buy an actual accurate thermometer for the ambient temp. 

Sorry for the rambling but TLDR save the money and just buy the original weber 22 and mod it
Results.Title: Good customer service, quality and product lacking

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
